_comment: #133 product table v1 (issue comment 6357431318): Auto picks a model by task type when the user names none. Categories are checked in order; the first whose keywords appear in the prompt wins, else 'default' (the feature default from curated_models.json). A model missing from the catalog falls back to the feature default (logged). Edit this table to recalibrate; no code change needed.

default.zh: 这是通用生图的默认模型
default.en: the default model for general image generation

categories.zh: 这是 Logo / 图标 / 矢量风格任务
categories.en: this is a logo, icon or vector-style task

categories.zh: 这是海报 / 信息图 / 带文字的任务
categories.en: this is a poster, infographic or text-heavy task

categories.zh: 这是动漫 / 插画 / 艺术风格任务
categories.en: this is an anime, illustration or art-style task

categories.zh: 这是写实人像 / 产品摄影 / 电商主图任务
categories.en: this is a photoreal portrait, product photo or e-commerce shot

multi_reference.zh: 给了 {n} 张参考图，需要多图参考和角色或产品一致
multi_reference.en: {n} reference images were given, which needs multi-reference and character or product consistency

masked.zh: 这是带选区或涂抹蒙版的局部编辑（#45），只改选区，用精度更高的模型
masked.en: this is an edit with a selection or brushed mask (#45), which only changes the selection and uses the more precise model

default.zh: 这是通用图片编辑的默认模型
default.en: the default model for general image editing

categories.zh: 这是要保持人物或产品一致的局部修改
categories.en: this is a local edit that must keep the person or product consistent
this is a photoreal photo retouch
